integrity: The proof is analytic and is corroborated by exact symbolic and finite numerical checks; finite checks are not a proof of the continuum claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact constant-step unsplit skew-isometric linear variational inequalities only; no generic monotone, proximal, variable-step or rounding guarantee. Full historical uniqueness has not been independently established.
title: A sharp two-parameter rate barrier for skew golden-ratio iterations
